name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening. Tass eliminated seven players in a single Miami paintball game, a Miami record. So does that number redefine individual impact, or is it just one great outing?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, pull up...this ain't just a one-time flex, Tass just raised the ceiling for every player in Miami. Nobody’s clockin' the bar now without running through that seven-player impact. The game’s changed, period.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Now hold on, Cassius. That's a heck of a game, no doubt, but one big swing doesn't rewrite the whole playbook for how we measure individual impact.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, is that a new standard, or just the current high mark? Andrew, if repeated it's a standard, but a record only counts once. So which are we actually debating, the man's ceiling or the sport's?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, here’s the scoop...the record’s the headline, the new ceiling’s the story. One epic showing flips the game from ‘what if’ to ‘what’s next.
